recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current source satisfies FHIR-13000 after later MedicationStatement/adherence decisions; revisit only if the unresolved FHIR-54453 Timing question becomes a final Pharmacy decision requiring a separate update.
issue_request: FHIR-13000 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request raised and applied for DSTU2. It asked for additional guidance on populating effectiveTime/effective date wording, specifically to make MedicationStatement.effective[x] use present and past tense consistent with MedicationStatement taken wording.
initial_application: Jira records fhir-svn commit d27f7663ee1951aafb30c6ed4e219c9794dd6fd8 as the application. That commit changed only MedicationStatement spreadsheet sources, updating effective[x] short text to use is/was/will tense and the definition to say the patient is/was/will be taking the medication, with the then-current MedicationStatement.taken reference.
additional_context: The current build uses XML StructureDefinition sources, and source/fhir.ini lists MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement as active resources. MedicationPrescription has become MedicationRequest, and MedicationAdministration.effective[x] is represented by current MedicationAdministration.occurrence[x] rename metadata. Later published MedicationStatement decisions, especially FHIR-31573 and already-audited FHIR-22109, corrected the obsolete taken/status references so current wording uses MedicationStatement.adherence. FHIR-54453 is only Triaged and unresolved, so it is background rather than final guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active MedicationStatement StructureDefinition already says the medication is/was/will be taken and defines the asserted interval as is/was/will be taking, with non-taking represented by MedicationStatement.adherence Not Taking. The MedicationStatement event mapping exception mirrors the same wording, and no additional active source location was found that would change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Removed obsolete MedicationStatement/MedicationUsage taken and wasNotTaken references from the same effective[x] wording family; already represented on the combined branch.
